outcome: expression of CD-68 marker in Hofbauer cells (HCs) in placentas
distribution of Hofbauer cells (HCs) within the villi in placentas
cohort: The study included 60 placentas: 30 from mothers with diagnosed GDM (cases) and 30 from non-diabetic mothers (controls).
finding: The number of immunostained CD68+ Hofbauer cells was significantly higher, and their distribution more frequent in relation to fetal blood vessels, in the placentas of mothers with GDM compared to controls.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth/delivery (placenta examination)
